name: SQuAD
full_name: Superconducting Qubit Advantage for Dark Matter
summary: A proposed high-frequency axion search using superconducting-qubit single-photon readout.
detection_principle: A high-Q dielectric cavity converts axions in a magnetic field; qubits perform single-photon or quantum-nondemolition measurements to avoid the vacuum noise of phase-preserving linear amplification.

key_parameters.value: 10–30 GHz; DFSZ sensitivity is a design goal

results.summary: The Snowmass document describes physics goals and technology; it does not establish that the final-scale instrument has completed data-taking.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
